comment: Written for gEdit (synthetic, not for a machine); see README.md here.
description: Siemens two channels: channel 1 jumps with GOTOF SKIP1, outside every IF block, over a whole IF R1==1 … ENDIF block that holds its WAITM(2,1,2); channel 2 waits on mark 3 before mark 2. The jump always runs, so it is followed: channel 1 never runs mark 2 and channel 2 waits for it for ever, reported as missing.
